title: Radial pinching and topological rigidity for free boundary Gaussian $f$-minimal submanifolds
summary: Let $M^k\subset \overline{B}_R^N$ be a smooth compact connected orientable free boundary $f_c$-minimal submanifold of the closed Euclidean ball, where $f_c(x)=c|x|^2/2$ and $c\ge 0$. Assume that $cR^2\le k$ and $|A_{x^\perp}|^2\le 1+\frac{1}{k-1}(1-c|x^\perp|^2)^2$, where $A_{x^\perp}(X,Y)=\langle x^\perp,A(X,Y)\rangle$. We prove that $M$ is diffeomorphic either to $D^k$ or to $S^1\times D^{k-1}$; strict pinching yields the disk.
